description: Generate a product marketing video using a reference video, reference images, and model-specific generation settings.

aspectRatio.description: Target video aspect ratio supported by the selected model.

productInfo.description: Concise product information used to guide the recreation. Maximum 2500 characters.
productInfo.example: Slim shockproof phone case with a clear finish.

refImageList.description: Public image URLs for product or visual references.

refVideoUrl.description: Public URL of the reference video.

resolution.description: Target video resolution supported by the selected model, such as 720p or 1080p.

saleCountry.description: Target market country code used to localize the recreated video.

targetLanguage.description: Target spoken and on-screen language for the recreated video.

videoTime.description: Optional target video duration in seconds. Seedance 2.0, Fast, Mini, and HappyHorse V2 support any integer from 5 through 15; Seedance 2.5 supports 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, or 30.

videoType.description: Video model. Supported values: seedance-2-0, seedance-2-0-fast, seedance-2-0-mini, seedance-2-5, or happyhorse-v2.
